evidence: Authored Windows fixture using real OS threads and critical-section APIs under Wine; no game loaded
checks: Foreign-thread TryEnterCriticalSection refused while owner holds lock
Intermediate recursive releases do not permit acquisition
Final release permits bounded waiter completion
Protected section has at most one worker inside
Main thread can reacquire after all workers finish
limitations: Authored fixture calls Windows APIs directly; game adapters and game objects not loaded.
Try-enter confirms competing owner; event readiness does not prove exact OS blocking arrival time.
Bounded scheduling scenarios are not fairness, stress, memory-order or arbitrary-game-lock-order proof.
No game lifetime, destructor safety or plugin unload qualification.
